 Give Your Innerwear Drawer a Refresh With Bras, Shapewear, and More From Herah at 50% Off This 11.11
 Deals 
 November 11, 2026 
 Regine Tan 
 Finding innerwear that feels comfortable and works with your everyday outfits is a good place to start when refreshing your wardrobe. Herah offers a range of bras, panties, and shapewear designed to suit different preferences and needs, from everyday wear to specific outfit choices. 
 This 11.11, you can shop some of the brand’s bestsellers at up to 50% off. Here are a few pieces worth adding to your shopping list. 
 1. Herah T-Shirt Wireless Bra 
 Photo: Herah on Shopee
 A good everyday bra is one you can wear under different outfits, and Herah’s T-Shirt Wireless Bra is designed with that in mind. It’s made from a buttery-soft, breathable stretch fabric and features lightly padded 3D molded cups for natural shaping and coverage. 
 The seamless finish helps it stay discreet under fitted shirts, while its adjustable straps and hook-and-eye back closure allow you to adjust the fit. BUY IT HERE! 
 2. Herah Seamless Buckle Bra (2pcs.) 
 Photo: Herah on Shopee
 If you prefer a bra with a more secure back closure, the Seamless Buckle Bra comes in a two-piece set. It has a V-neckline, lightly padded cups with removable pads, and adjustable straps. Its wireless construction and stretch fabric provide support without the feel of an underwire, while the seamless finish helps prevent visible lines under clothing. 
 The bra is available in different shades and sizes, including options for petite to plus-size shoppers. BUY IT HERE! 
 3. Herah Hipster Seamless Panty (5pcs.) 
 Photo: Herah on Shopee
 For everyday underwear, Herah’s Hipster Seamless Panty set comes with five pieces and is available in a range of colors and sizes. The panties are made from a soft microfiber blend with seamless edges designed to stay discreet under fitted clothes. They also feature a cotton gusset, wider sides for added coverage, and a stretchable fabric blend of nylon and spandex. 
 It’s one of the brand’s best-selling panty styles, with sizes ranging from XS to 5XL. BUY IT HERE! 
 4. Herah Jelly Grip Shapewear Shorts 
 Photo: Herah on Shopee
 If you’re looking for an extra-smoothing layer under dresses, skirts, or fitted outfits, the Jelly Grip Shapewear Shorts are worth a look. Available in high-waist and mid-waist options, they feature targeted compression to smooth the abdomen, waist, and thighs, along with contoured butt support to enhance your natural shape.
 The jelly-grip waistband and flexible boning help prevent rolling and slipping, while the high-waist variant comes with removable straps for added underbust support. Made with soft, breathable, and durable SENSIL® fabric (77% nylon and 23% spandex), they’re available in sizes XS to 5XL. BUY IT HERE! 
 5. Herah Silicone Nipple Covers 
 Photo: Herah on Shopee
 For backless dresses, strapless tops, and outfits where bra straps might show, Herah’s Silicone Nipple Covers offer a discreet alternative. Made from medical-grade silicone, they have a thin, matte finish designed to blend under clothing without adding visible bulk. The covers use an adhesive backing for a secure hold of up to 12 hours and are washable and reusable with proper care. They’re available in three shades, Dulce, Mocha, and Tan, as well as two sizes for different cup ranges. BUY IT HERE! 
 6. Herah Push Up Silicone Bra 
 Photo: Herah on Shopee
 If you want more lift without wearing a traditional bra, the Push Up Silicone Bra is designed for outfits with plunging necklines, open backs, and fitted silhouettes. It uses medical-grade adhesive to stay in place without straps or a back closure, while its push-up design creates a more enhanced shape. It’s waterproof and sweat-resistant, with an advertised wear time of six to eight hours. The bra is available in cup sizes A to D and comes in Dulce and Mocha. BUY IT HERE! 
 7. Herah Non-Adhesive Silicone Nipple Cover 
 Photo: Herah on Shopee
 For those who prefer not to have adhesive directly on their nipples, Herah also offers a Nips-Free Silicone Nipple Cover. It features a non-adhesive center that helps reduce direct contact with the sensitive nipple area, while an adhesive outer ring secures the cover to the skin. The design is opaque, seamless, and water-resistant, making it an option for backless and strapless outfits. It’s available in 8 cm and 10 cm sizes, with proper washing and care allowing for repeated use. BUY IT HERE! 
 From everyday bras and multipack panties to strapless styles and shapewear, Herah has several innerwear essentials worth browsing this sale season. Head to its official Shopee store to check out the available styles, find your size, and shop selected innerwear at up to 50% off this 11.11.
